title: Worker Profile Schema
description: Database schema and field details of worker profiles in Rozgar Connect

userId.description: Links the profile to the main User document

categories.validation: Must contain at least 1 category name; values are trimmed and stored in lowercase
categories.description: The types of services the worker offers (e.g. ['plumber', 'electrician'])

city.description: The city where the worker operates

area.description: The specific neighborhood or area within the city

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp contact number for instant customer messaging links

description.description: A description of the worker's experience, tools, and services offered

photo.description: Web path to the uploaded profile photo file (/uploads/photo-...)

idCardFront.description: Web path to the uploaded ID card front image

idCardBack.description: Web path to the uploaded ID card back image

isVerified.description: Flag showing whether the worker's identity is verified by admin

verificationStatus.description: The current stage of the worker's verification review lifecycle

averageRating.description: Weighted average rating from all reviews, rounded to the nearest decimal (1 place)

reviewCount.description: The total count of reviews written for this worker profile

database_indexes.purpose: Optimizes queries filtering workers by service categories and locations
Optimizes sorting workers by rating in descending order

notes: Schema timestamps: true automatically adds createdAt and updatedAt fields to the profile document.
